title: JPEGated
tagline: A ticketing system, exclusively serving specific NFT holders, with access regulated by the Lit protocol.
description:
This is an JPEG(NFT) Gated content wall system. My interest lies in imbuing digital assets with tangibility, so this time I've ventured into bringing NFTs into the real world as tangible proof of ownership.

By providing a physical embodiment of NFTs, I believe we're not just expanding their use cases but also fostering a more cohesive community of NFT holders. This increased tangibility adds another dimension to the NFT experience, enhancing its value and appeal.
how_its_made:
This JPEG(NFT) gate, which is a content gate secured with an NFT key, is constructed using the proven Lit protocol. Working in tandem with next.js, Lit secures the definitions and content within the server, while seamlessly other public information and app functionality are disclosed without even noticed by user which part is server side and which part is not. 

To introduce tangibility, I employed the Instax Mini EVO as a mobile printer, and also beautiful pixelarts provided by Nouns DAO for this hackathon greatly increased tangibility of my app.
